request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. No letters, words, logos or brand marks anywhere, and no number anywhere except the two candle digits described: no other candles, cards, signs, clocks, screens or clothes show any digit.

Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.

It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.

The people are ordinary adults who are not famous and do not look like any earlier course photo; nobody looks at the camera.

A smiling grandmother with short grey hair sits at a light wooden table in a bright living room behind a round white birthday cake. On the cake stand two large, thick number candles, the digits 7 and 4 side by side (reading 74), each as tall as her hand, upright, facing the camera, sharp and easy to read.
